# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    T AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
        FROM Orders
        WHERE order_type = 0
    )
SELECT *
FROM Orders AS o
WHERE order_type = 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T AS t WHERE t.customer_id = o.customer_id);
